text:
A student wants to demagnetise a steel bar. He uses the apparatus shown. He switches on the
circuit for a few seconds and then switches off. He finds that the steel bar is still magnetised.
steel bar
coil
a.c.
supply
What should he do to improve his method?
A
change the supply from an alternating to a direct voltage
B
use a lower alternating voltage
C
remove the steel bar from the coil whilst the circuit is switched on
D
use a coil that has fewer turns on it

options.label: A
options.text: change the supply from an alternating to a direct voltage

options.label: C
options.text: remove the steel bar from the coil whilst the circuit is switched on

options.label: D
options.text: use a coil that has fewer turns on it
